messages.content:
Risk: Over/Under-reliance
Description: Users may inappropriately rely on the AI system for critical decisions or tasks beyond its capabilities, or fail to put trust in AI systems when they should, potentially leading to errors or safety issues.
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 4/10 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000146: Artificial Language — A Language that is developed through conscious planning and premeditation, rather than one that was developed through use and repetition. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Natural Language
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 2/10 queries]
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001075: Act of Training Instruction — An Act of Training performed by an Agent by imparting knowledge to another Agent. [found by 2/10 queries]
  Siblings: Act of Training Acquisition

axes.rationale: The risk involves users' reliance on AI systems, which are software agents, for critical decisions. The agent role is relevant as it pertains to the entity (AI system) that users may over-rely on or under-rely on.
The risk of over/under-reliance can lead to errors or safety issues, which may involve algorithmic discrimination as a potential consequence of inappropriate reliance on AI systems.
